code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    gaps=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1,w-1):
            if row[c]==0 and row[c-1]!=0 and row[c-1]==row[c+1]:
                gaps.append((r,c,row[c-1]))
                out[r][c]=row[c-1]
    # Each horizontal bar's gap sends its color upward; later (higher) bars take precedence.
    for r,c,color in gaps:
        for rr in range(r):
            out[rr][c]=color
    return out
'''
